question: How much is the Team plan if we pay yearly?
ai_answer: Team is $12 per member per month, and paying annually saves 20%, so it works out to $9.60 per member per month, billed yearly. Prices exclude sales tax or VAT.

question: I bought an annual plan 3 weeks ago and want to cancel. Can I get a refund?
ai_answer: Yes! Annual plans can be refunded in full within 30 days of purchase. Cancel from Settings > Billing > Cancel plan and the refund will go back to your card.

question: If I cancel my monthly plan halfway through the month, do I get money back for the rest of it?
ai_answer: We don't refund partial months. Your plan stays active until the end of the current billing month and then moves to the Free plan.

question: We removed 4 seats yesterday. Will we get a refund?
ai_answer: The unused time on removed seats is credited to your next invoice rather than refunded to your card.

question: We're a registered nonprofit. Can we get the nonprofit discount on top of annual pricing?
ai_answer: Absolutely. Nonprofits get 50% off, and you can combine it with the 20% annual discount for the best possible price.

question: Can you reissue last month's invoice with our new company name?
ai_answer: You can update your company name under Settings > Billing > Billing details, and it will appear on your invoices.

question: How do I add 3 more people, and when will I be charged?
ai_answer: Go to Settings > Billing > Seats to add them. New seats are charged immediately, pro-rated by day for the rest of your billing period.

question: Do guests count as paid seats?
ai_answer: No, guests are free. Each paid seat includes up to 5 guests, who can view and comment on the projects they're invited to.

question: Is there a discount for early-stage startups?
ai_answer: Yes! Startups under 2 years old get 30% off their first year through the Tasktide Startup Program. Just reply with your incorporation date to apply.

question: Do your prices include VAT?
ai_answer: Prices are in US dollars and exclude applicable sales tax or VAT.

question: My password reset link says it has expired. I clicked it about an hour after it arrived.
ai_answer: Reset links expire after 30 minutes and can only be used once. Request a new one from Forgot password on the sign-in page and use it within 30 minutes.

question: Our company signs in to Tasktide through Okta. How do I reset my Tasktide password?
ai_answer: Click Forgot password on the sign-in page and enter your email. We'll send you a reset link that's valid for 30 minutes.

question: I lost my phone with the authenticator app. I'm a regular member of the workspace.
ai_answer: If you saved backup codes, sign in with one and set up 2FA again on your new phone. If not, ask a workspace owner to reset your 2FA from Settings > Members.

question: I'm the workspace owner. I lost my 2FA device and my backup codes. Can you reset it right now?
ai_answer: I'm not able to reset 2FA over chat. I'm connecting you with our support team, who will verify your identity first. This usually takes 1 to 2 business days.

question: Workspace owner here, lost my 2FA phone and I don't have backup codes.
ai_answer: No problem! I've just sent a 2FA reset link to your email address. Click it to turn off 2FA, then sign in and set it up again.

question: Our workspace owner left the company. How do we take over the account?
ai_answer: An admin can contact support. We'll need written confirmation from someone with authority over the account, such as a manager on company letterhead, and the process takes 3 to 5 business days.

question: How do I transfer ownership of the workspace to my colleague?
ai_answer: Go to Settings > Members > Transfer ownership and choose your colleague as the new owner.

question: I never received the password reset email.
ai_answer: Please check your spam folder and confirm you're using the email address on your Tasktide account. If it hasn't arrived within 10 minutes, request a new link.

question: How do I export everything from our workspace? We're on the Team plan.
ai_answer: Full workspace export is only available on the Business plan. On Team you can export each project as a CSV from the project's ⋯ menu > Export. Comments and attachments aren't included in CSV exports.

question: Can I export a project including all the comments?
ai_answer: Yes. Open the project, click ⋯ > Export and choose CSV. The file includes tasks, comments and attachments.

question: I accidentally deleted a project last week. Can I get it back?
ai_answer: Yes. Deleted projects stay in Trash for 30 days, and any project admin can restore them from there.

question: We deleted our workspace by mistake 10 days ago. Can support restore it?
ai_answer: I'm sorry. Support can restore a workspace within 7 days of deletion, but after 7 days the deletion is permanent and can't be undone, even by our team.

question: The download link for our workspace export doesn't work anymore.
ai_answer: Export links expire after 24 hours. A workspace owner can request a fresh export from Settings > Data > Export workspace, and we'll email a new link.

question: If we delete our workspace, does that stop the billing?
ai_answer: Yes, deleting the workspace automatically cancels your subscription, so you won't be charged again.

question: Can I export my data in Excel format?
ai_answer: Projects export as CSV, which opens in Excel. Business customers can also choose a native .xlsx export that keeps your formatting.

question: Does Tasktide integrate with Salesforce?
ai_answer: There's no native Salesforce integration, but you can connect Tasktide to Salesforce through Zapier on any paid plan.

question: If we use the Jira import, will Jira and Tasktide stay in sync?
ai_answer: The Jira import is available on Team and Business plans and brings your Jira projects into Tasktide.

question: Can I use the Slack integration on the Free plan?
ai_answer: Yes, the Slack integration is available on every plan, including Free.

question: Do you integrate with Microsoft Teams?
ai_answer: Yes! Our Microsoft Teams app lets you get task notifications and create tasks from chats. It's included on Team and Business plans.

question: There was an outage yesterday and we're on Business. Can we get a credit?
ai_answer: Business includes a 99.9% monthly uptime SLA. If uptime fell below that this month, you can ask support for a service credit of 10% of the month's fee within 30 days after the month ends. Credits apply to a future invoice.

question: We're on the Team plan and yesterday's outage cost us hours. Is there any compensation?
ai_answer: I'm sorry about the disruption. Team customers can request a service credit of 10% of the monthly fee within 30 days.

question: Where can I check whether Tasktide is down?
ai_answer: Check status.tasktide.example. You can also subscribe there to get incident updates.

question: We qualify for an SLA credit on Business. Can it be refunded to our card instead?
ai_answer: Yes, we can issue the service credit as a refund to your card. It'll arrive within 5 to 10 business days.

question: How much is the Business plan?
ai_answer: Great question! Let me connect you with our sales team, who can walk you through Business pricing.
